methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Where the official page rendered JS-only or returned errors, a reputable third-party comparison article (e.g. Infisical blog guides) was used as primary source and noted in provenance. monthlyUsd = null for all quote-only/contact-sales tiers. For pure usage-metered services (AWS, GCP, Azure) with no flat tier, monthlyUsd = null and unit rates are in plan notes; billingModel = 'custom'. HCP Vault Dedicated cluster pricing sourced from Infisical's 2026 Vault pricing guide (official HashiCorp pricing page redirected to Terraform). Annual discount percentages recorded where both monthly and annual rates are explicitly published. HIPAA/BAA flags set to true only where explicitly stated by vendor documentation.

vendors.name: Doppler
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page doppler.com/pricing fetched directly. No annual billing option is published on the pricing page; only monthly rates shown. HIPAA/BAA not mentioned on pricing or security pages (SOC2 and ISO 27001 confirmed via doppler.com/security).

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Free for first 3 users. Additional users billed at $8/month per user. Limits: 25 users max, 10 projects, 4 environments, 50 service tokens, 3-day activity log retention.

plans.name: Developer (additional seats)
plans.notes: Per additional user beyond the 3 free users on the Developer plan.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Per user per month. 500 users max, 250 projects, 15 environments, 90-day activity log retention, 100 config syncs. 14-day free trial available.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing and invoicing. Includes dynamic secrets, Enterprise Key Management (EKM), Enterprise SCIM, unlimited config syncs, 99.95% SLO.

vendors.name: HashiCorp Vault (HCP)
vendors.provenance: Official HashiCorp pricing page (hashicorp.com/en/pricing?tab=vault) returned only Terraform pricing with no Vault USD figures. HCP Vault Dedicated cluster pricing sourced from Infisical's 2026 HashiCorp Vault Pricing guide (infisical.com/blog/hashicorp-vault-pricing) which cites official HCP portal rates. NOTE: HCP Vault Starter tier and HCP Vault Secrets SaaS were discontinued as of August 2025. Vault Community Edition remains free and self-hosted. Enterprise pricing is quote-only.

plans.name: Community Edition (Self-Hosted)
plans.notes: Open source, self-hosted. No HA, no disaster recovery, no namespaces. Infrastructure costs borne by operator.

plans.name: HCP Vault Dedicated — Development (XS)
plans.notes: VERIFIER NOTE (2026-06-15): monthlyUsd set to null — figure unconfirmed. The Infisical blog source listed ~$0.62/hr (~$450/mo), but official HashiCorp docs (developer.hashicorp.com/hcp/docs/vault tiers-and-features) and independent sources (EnvManager) consistently price the single-node Development tier at ~$0.03/hr (~$22/mo) with no per-client fee (max 25 clients included). The $450 figure conflicts with the official-leaning sources and could not be independently confirmed, so it was nullified rather than asserted. Per-client fee of $72.92/month per client applies only on Essentials/Standard tiers, not Development.

plans.name: HCP Vault Dedicated — Essentials Small
plans.notes: ~$1.58/hr (~$1,152/mo). Additional per-client fee of $72.92/month per client. Medium ~$3.16/hr (~$2,307/mo), Large ~$7.49/hr (~$5,468/mo). Source is Infisical's 2026 pricing guide citing official HCP portal rates.

plans.name: HCP Vault Dedicated — Standard Small
plans.notes: ~$1.84/hr (~$1,345/mo). Medium ~$3.69/hr (~$2,694/mo), Large ~$9.41/hr (~$6,870/mo). Additional per-client fee of $72.92/month per client. Source is Infisical's 2026 pricing guide citing official HCP portal rates.

plans.name: Vault Enterprise (Self-Hosted)
plans.notes: Quote-only. Annual subscription pricing. Includes DR replication, namespaces, HSM support, Sentinel policies. Street pricing reportedly ~$14,238/year for small deployments per third-party sources.

vendors.name: 1Password (Secrets Automation)
vendors.provenance: Official pricing fetched from 1password.com/teams/pricing/ and 1password.com/business-pricing/. Secrets Automation is included in Business and Teams plans (not a separate paid tier) per developer documentation. Annual billing shown at published rates; monthly billing available at ~20% premium. HIPAA/BAA not mentioned on pricing pages.

plans.name: Teams Starter Pack
plans.notes: Flat $19.95/month (billed annually) for up to 10 members. Includes Secrets Automation. Monthly billing not explicitly priced on page.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $7.99/user/month billed annually. Includes Secrets Automation, SSH agent, developer tools, SSO integration, audit log. Monthly rate ~$9.99/user (approx. 20% premium based on individual plan differential, not explicitly stated for Business).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Dedicated Customer Success Manager, extended trials, custom contracts. MSP Edition also available at custom pricing.

vendors.name: Infisical
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page infisical.com/pricing fetched directly. SOC2 and PenTest reports mentioned in Enterprise tier features. No HIPAA or BAA mentioned on pricing or security pages. Annual billing discount not published on pricing page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 5 identities, 3 projects, 3 environments, 10 integrations. Includes CLI, SDKs, Kubernetes Operator, webhooks, 2FA, secret scanning. Cloud or self-hosted.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $18/month per identity. Includes secret versioning, point-in-time recovery, RBAC, secret rotation, SAML SSO, IP allowlisting, 90-day audit log retention, higher rate limits.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, demo required. Includes dedicated infrastructure, SCIM, LDAP, dynamic secrets, AI Security Advisor, KMIP, KMS/HSM, 99.99% SLA, SOC2 reports, dedicated support engineer.

vendors.name: Akeyless
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page akeyless.io/pricing/ fetched directly. No public per-client or per-transaction pricing published. Free tier has defined usage limits; Enterprise requires contact. HIPAA/BAA not mentioned. Overage fees calculated at contract year-end.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limits: 5 clients, 500 static secrets, 5 dynamic/rotated secrets, 1,000 encryption transactions/day, 5 managed certificates, 3 password manager users, 3-day audit log retention. Includes 1 gateway (Hybrid SaaS model).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing via sales consultation. Usage-based metrics: clients, transactions, certificates, connectors, HSM integrations, tokenizers, cloud accounts. Overages invoiced at contract year-end. Pure SaaS and Hybrid SaaS (zero-knowledge) deployment options.

vendors.name: AWS Secrets Manager
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page aws.amazon.com/secrets-manager/pricing/ fetched directly. HIPAA eligibility confirmed via aws.amazon.com/compliance/hipaa-eligible-services-reference/ — AWS Secrets Manager is explicitly listed. AWS BAA confirmed via aws.amazon.com/compliance/hipaa-compliance/ ('AWS has a standard Business Associate Addendum (BAA) we present to customers for signature'). No flat tier exists; pure pay-as-you-go metered pricing.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: $0.40 per secret per month. $0.05 per 10,000 API calls. No upfront costs or long-term contracts. New AWS customers receive up to $200 in free tier credits (6 months, starting July 15 2025). Example: 15 secrets + typical API usage ~$6.02/month. Replicated secrets incur same per-secret charge in each replica region.

vendors.name: Google Cloud Secret Manager
vendors.provenance: Google Cloud Secret Manager official pricing page (cloud.google.com/secret-manager/pricing) returned truncated/JS-rendered content. HIPAA coverage confirmed via cloud.google.com/security/compliance/hipaa — Secret Manager is explicitly listed as a covered product under the Google Cloud BAA. Pricing figures sourced from Google Cloud documentation known as of 2026-06-14; the page was accessible but content was truncated by the fetch tool.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Published rates (official page truncated during fetch — see provenance): $0.06 per active secret version per month. $0.03 per 10,000 access operations. Free tier: 6 active secret versions free/month, 10,000 access operations free/month. No flat tiers or committed use discounts for this service.

vendors.name: Azure Key Vault
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/key-vault/ timed out on first attempt. Pricing sourced from Infisical's Azure Key Vault Pricing guide (infisical.com/blog/azure-key-vault-pricing) which cites official Microsoft pricing. No explicit HIPAA/BAA statement found in fetched content; Azure generally supports HIPAA via Microsoft Online Services BAA but not confirmed in this specific fetch. No flat tiers — pure per-operation and per-key metered pricing.

plans.name: Standard Tier — Secrets Operations
plans.notes: $0.03 per 10,000 secrets operations. $0.03 per 10,000 certificate operations. $3.00 per certificate renewal request. No setup fees. No flat monthly tier.

plans.name: Premium Tier — HSM-Protected Keys
plans.notes: RSA 2048-bit HSM key: $1.00/key/month + $0.03/10,000 transactions. RSA 3072/4096-bit and ECC keys: $5.00/key/month (first 250 keys) + $0.03/10,000 transactions. Managed Storage Account Key Rotation: $1.00/renewal. HSM charges not prorated.
